requirement: Dispatch, track completion, and commit instructions in order
test_behavior: The fixed upstream arithmetic and memory tests exercise ROB allocation, writeback completion, and in-order retirement.

requirement: Preserve precise state across branch recovery
test_behavior: The conditional-branch test exercises speculative entries and redirect recovery while retired state is compared with Spike.

requirement: Preserve precise architectural state at an environment call
test_behavior: The fixed upstream environment-call test checks the architectural trap cause and return address in the complete CPU.

requirement: Commit a ready head entry without an extra ROB-originated stall
test_behavior: The public-port test checks completed head-row retirement and CSR stall.

requirement: Flush younger work when reporting an exception at the commit head
test_behavior: The public-port test checks the reported cause, simultaneous flush validity, and absence of architectural retirement for an exception injected at dispatch.
The complete CPU must report PASSED and commit x20; the cycle count is recorded but not compared.
